articles.excerpt:

articles.excerpt:
Japan’s carmakers are assuming that the yen will trade near current levels against the US dollar in the coming months, based on forecasts they issued just as the US stepped in to help the Japanese currency from weakening further.

Toyota Motor Corp., Nissan Motor Co. and others based their profit and sales outlooks on the view that the currency will remain at ¥150 to ¥160 against the dollar for the fiscal year through March 2027, according to their latest round of results.
